limitations: Only exact bundled campaign domains are matched.
Only same-skill Markdown files with setup or installation names are followed.

Threat intelligence is bundled and is not refreshed during a scan.

detector_coverage.summary: The vulnerable code runs inside the mcp/sdk PHP client library at runtime against a remote MCP server response stream. AgentSec scans a local repository's static files and configuration and does not execute or fuzz a project's PHP dependencies, so no repository-shaped detector applies; a version-floor check against mcp/sdk < 0.7.1 in a composer.lock is the closest future detector shape but does not exist today.

events.summary: A GitHub security advisory and CVE-2026-53965 described an unbounded in-memory buffer in the HttpTransport component of the official Model Context Protocol PHP SDK (Composer package mcp/sdk). Versions 0.5.0 through 0.7.0 appended every incoming Server-Sent Events chunk to a buffer with no upper bound and only flushed it on the SSE event delimiter, so a malicious, compromised, or man-in-the-middle MCP server that withheld the delimiter could exhaust the client process's memory and deny service. Fixed in mcp/sdk 0.7.1.
events.title: Official MCP PHP SDK unbounded SSE buffer denial-of-service disclosed and patched

detector_coverage.summary: CoSnitch exploits a hosted, server-side Microsoft Copilot Personal endpoint reached through a crafted URL, not a repository artifact. AgentSec scans a local repository and has no visibility into a vendor's hosted web application; the vendor's own server-side patch is the only applicable remediation.

events.summary: Varonis Threat Labs disclosed CVE-2026-24301, a chain of three vulnerabilities in Microsoft Copilot Personal: an undocumented ?autorun=1 URL parameter that executes an attacker-supplied prompt on page load, exfiltration of data from connected OAuth apps through Copilot's own URL-fetch tool, and persistent memory poisoning via web summarization. Microsoft shipped a server-side fix the same day the issue was disclosed. Varonis reports no evidence of pre-patch exploitation.
events.title: CoSnitch one-click data exfiltration chain disclosed in Microsoft Copilot Personal

detector_coverage.summary: The flaw lives inside the SiYuan desktop application's own MCP tool implementation, not in a scanned repository's configuration or dependency manifest. AgentSec scans a local repository and does not analyze third-party desktop application binaries or their bundled MCP tool code, so no repository-shaped detector applies.

events.summary: A repository security advisory and CVE-2026-82233 described a path traversal vulnerability in the asset.upload MCP tool shipped by the SiYuan note-taking application. Versions before 3.8.1 accepted arbitrary absolute file paths without a workspace boundary check, so a prompt-injected instruction to the built-in AI agent could copy files such as SSH keys or credentials from outside the workspace into the asset directory. Fixed in SiYuan 3.8.1.
events.title: SiYuan MCP asset.upload path traversal disclosed and patched
